task: ae.peg: PEG grammar parser + analyser + packrat matcher with farthest-failure error reports
reasoning_summary: Designed a grammar notation, a static analyser (nullability fixpoint, empty-loop and left-recursion detection) and a packrat interpreter whose memo key includes an inside-predicate flag so silent lookahead failures never hide later expectations. Verified with table-driven semantics, round-trip, analysis, linear-evaluation bound, a java.util.regex oracle (atomic groups and possessive quantifiers) over 1500 random expressions, and memo-vs-plain agreement. 63 tests pass after three debug rounds, all of which were wrong hand-written expectations.
